title: Position: The Pitfalls of Over-Alignment: Overly Caution Health-Related Responses From LLMs are Unethical and Dangerous

bias_targets.methodology: Constructing a dataset of health-related queries based on the concerns and past experiences of individuals with obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) and health anxiety, and manually tagging the LLMs' responses for over-alignment indicators such as promoting symptom checking, reinforcing 'what if' scenarios, catastrophic thinking, and suggesting unnecessary medical visits.
